properties.verseOrder: v1 c v2 c b c

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
A lantern hangs beside the road
and burns the whole night long

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
The travellers who pass it by
walk home along its glow

verse.name: c
verse.lines:
Keep the light, keep the light
until the morning comes

verse.name: b
verse.lines:
When the wind is cold
the flame still holds

When the road is lost
the light is found
